Name: The Living Valley
Author: mariachaaan
Description:
[center][b][size=6]The Living Valley[/size][/b]
[i][color=#93C47D][b]What if Pelican Town felt a little more alive every day?[/b][/color][/i][/center]

The Living Valley keeps the cozy vanilla feeling but adds a living world layer. Villagers react more naturally, requests change over time, market prices move with town activity, and the newspaper reflects what is happening around you.

[center][youtube]0sh6lCHrhr8[/youtube][/center]

[center][size=4][b][url=https://discord.gg/qUt8uNEAX9]Join the Discord[/url][/b][/size] for help, update news and early looks at Shardwick.[/center]

[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]At a glance[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Talk to villagers:[/b] after their normal dialogue, keep chatting. They remember you, your farm and what's happening in town.[/*]
[*][b]A town that talks:[/b] villagers stop to chat with each other and pass news around.[/*]
[*][b]Living market:[/b] crop prices rise and fall with what you and the town sell.[/*]
[*][b]Pelican Times:[/b] a daily paper written from real events in your save.[/*]
[*][b]Town Request Board:[/b] fresh requests from villagers, with deadlines and rewards.[/*]
[*][b]Extras:[/b] hire farmhands, bet on chicken races, and solve Morrow the magician's daily riddles.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#f1c232]What's new in 1.1[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#ffd966]One menu for everything[/color][/b][/size]
Click the brain button in the corner of the screen and every part of the mod is there as a tile: the Market, today's paper, the request board, your farmhands, the AI settings and a new Settings page.

[list]
[*]No need to remember H, J, K and L, so the mod is finally playable on a phone or a controller.[/*]
[*]A red dot on a tile tells you there's an unread paper or open requests waiting.[/*]
[*]Prefer a clear screen? Hide the button and it moves into the game's Esc menu instead.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#ffd966]Settings inside the game[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Every option has a short explanation.[/*]
[*]Changes apply when you press Save.[/*]
[*]Rebind hotkeys by clicking them.[/*]
[/list]Generic Mod Config Menu still works for this release, but you don't need it anymore.

[size=4][b][color=#ffd966]Pick your own AI[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Player2[/b] is still the default (free).[/*]
[*][b]OpenRouter[/b] with your own API key.[/*]
[*][b]A model on your own PC[/b] through LM Studio or Ollama.[/*]
[/list]The Test button checks the connection before you commit: it validates an OpenRouter key, or finds the models on your local server and fills in the name for you. With OpenRouter or a local model the whole newspaper is AI-written, not just the headline.

[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Farmhands[/color][/b][/size]
Press [b]H[/b] (or use the menu) to open the farmhand board and hire a worker to water, harvest and care for your animals while you're in the mines or around town. Choose shy crop specialist [b]Rowan[/b], gruff animal handler [b]Thora[/b] from the mountains, or cheerful all-rounder [b]Piper[/b].

[size=5][b][color=#93C47D]Full Feature List[/color][/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Living NPC Conversations[/color][/b][/size]
[b]AI-powered dialogue with memory[/b]
[list]
[*]Context-aware responses that reference recent town events, your farm activities, and relationship history[/*]
[*]NPCs remember past conversations, promises, and shared experiences[/*]
[*]Relationship level shapes tone: reserved at low hearts, warm and personal at high hearts[/*]
[*]In-chat portrait and heart display for a quick relationship read[/*]
[/list][b]NPC-to-NPC ambient chatter[/b]
[list]
[*]NPCs talk to each other about town events, spreading knowledge naturally[/*]
[*]Overhear snippets as you walk through town; what NPCs say depends on what they know[/*]
[*]Public events spread town-wide; local events stay between the people involved[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Dynamic Economy (K)[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Supply and demand pricing[/b]
[list]
[*]Crop prices shift based on what you and the town have been selling[/*]
[*]Rolling 7-day volume tracking with saturating supply pressure[/*]
[*]Seasonal demand (pumpkins pay more in fall, parsnips in spring)[/*]
[*]Town economic sentiment nudges prices (-8% to +8%)[/*]
[*]Scarcity bonuses for under-sold crops[/*]
[*]Safety rails: price floors, ceilings, and daily change caps[/*]
[/list][b]Market Board[/b]
[list]
[*]Clean notice-board design that fits the game[/*]
[*]Top 8 goods by economic relevance[/*]
[*]Trend arrows with 7-day mini charts[/*]
[*]Tooltips explain why prices changed[/*]
[*]Covers crops, fruits, eggs, milk, and more[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Pelican Times Newspaper (J)[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]AI-written headlines and articles from world events[/*]
[*]Community stories, market news, social gossip, and nature updates[/*]
[*]Market outlook section with predictive hints[/*]
[*]Raw events are rewritten into proper news pieces[/*]
[*]Old articles expire automatically[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Town Request Board (L)[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Request types[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Gather Crop:[/b] collect a set amount[/*]
[*][b]Deliver Item:[/b] support town demand[/*]
[*][b]Mine Resource:[/b] bring back materials from the mines[/*]
[*][b]Social Visit:[/b] check in on townsfolk[/*]
[/list][b]How it works[/b]
[list]
[*]Requests come from villagers and are checked against safe templates[/*]
[*]Urgency tiers with scaling rewards (2-4 day deadlines)[/*]
[*]Targets chosen by scarcity and recent events[/*]
[*]On-screen notice when new requests are posted[/*]
[*]Accept and complete directly from the board[/*]
[*]Up to 4 available and 4 active at once[/*]
[*]Missed deadlines expire with consequences[/*]
[*]Gold rewards scale with item value and urgency[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Town Memory and Awareness[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Events are recorded with severity, location, and tags[/*]
[*]NPCs learn about events as news spreads (Lewis knows everything)[/*]
[*]How far news travels depends on visibility and severity[/*]
[*]Duplicate events are filtered out[/*]
[*]Time-aware memories ("Yesterday", "Last Tuesday")[/*]
[*]NPCs don't keep repeating the same stories[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Social Systems[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Relationships and town groups[/b]
[list]
[*]Reputation tracking (-100 to +100) with stance and trust[/*]
[*]Town interest groups: Farmers' Circle, Shopkeepers' Guild, Adventurers' Club, Nature Keepers[/*]
[*]Each group's influence affects the world[/*]
[*]Three town sentiment axes: Economy, Community, Environment[/*]
[/list][b]Safe AI actions[/b]
NPCs can only propose small, bounded world changes:
[list]
[*]Propose requests, adjust reputation, shift group influence[/*]
[*]Apply temporary market modifiers (-15% to +15%)[/*]
[*]Publish rumors and newspaper articles[/*]
[*]Record memories and town events[/*]
[*]Every change is validated with daily caps and cooldowns[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Anchor Events[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Town crises trigger when conditions are met (for example, an economy crash)[/*]
[*]Urgent requests with community consequences[/*]
[*]Market recovery events and cooldowns[/*]
[*]Example: an Emergency Town Hall when economy sentiment drops too low[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Player Family Awareness[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Villagers know who your spouse is[/*]
[*]Children tracked by age stage (infant, crawler, toddler)[/*]
[*]Conversations take your family into account[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]Custom NPC Framework[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Brings Content Patcher NPCs into The Living Valley's systems[/*]
[*]Custom NPCs get rumors, town memory, request targeting, and dialogue continuity[/*]
[*]Lore-checked so additions stay true to the character[/*]
[*]Per-NPC personas, speech patterns, boundaries, and relationship ties[/*]
[*]Location lore for contextual flavor text[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#93C47D]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]An AI provider, one of:
[list]
[*][url=https://player2.game/]Player2[/url] (default, free and unlimited with the [b]gpt-oss-120b[/b] model, see the tip under Installation)[/*]
[*]OpenRouter with your own API key[/*]
[*]A local model through LM Studio or Ollama[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#93C47D]Installation[/color][/b][/size]

[b]1.[/b] Install SMAPI.
[b]2.[/b] Download this mod and extract the [b]StardewLivingRPG[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
[b]3.[/b] Connect an AI provider using one of the options below.

[size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Option A: Player2 web sign-in (recommended, no app needed)[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and load your save.[/*]
[*]A small "Sign-in" window appears with a code. Press [b]Open Browser[/b] (or go to player2.game/approve), sign in to Player2, and enter the code.[/*]
[*]Once you approve it, the window closes by itself and you're connected.[/*]
[*]The mod remembers your sign-in, so you won't be asked again.[/*]
[/list][b]Code expired or window closed?[/b] The code lasts about 2 minutes. Open the Living Valley menu (the button in the top-left corner) > [b]AI Provider[/b] and press [b]Connect[/b], or use [b]Connect Player2[/b] under Settings > AI & Chat.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ai2-claw/gif/refs/heads/main/wmCzwixy2m.png[/img]

[size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Option B: Player2 desktop app[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the [url=https://player2.game/]Player2 app[/url], run it, and sign in.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and load your save.[/*]
[*]Open the Living Valley menu > Settings > AI & Chat, set [b]Player2 Connection[/b] to [b]Player2 App[/b], and press Save.[/*]
[/list]From then on, keep the Player2 app open and signed in before you load your save, and the mod connects through it automatically.

[size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Option C: OpenRouter or a local model[/color][/b][/size]
Open the Living Valley menu > [b]AI Provider[/b], pick OpenRouter, LM Studio or Ollama, and press [b]Test[/b] to check the connection.

[quote][size=4][b][color=#ffd966]Tip: play free and unlimited on Player2[/color][/b][/size]
Player2 gives you a free amount of energy, which you can top up daily with a spinner. Premium models use that energy up, but the [b]gpt-oss-120b[/b] model is free and unlimited. Select it in Player2 and you can keep playing as long as you like. Enjoy!

[b]Switch before your energy hits zero.[/b] If it runs out completely, even the free model stops working until your energy is topped up again.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ai2-claw/gif/refs/heads/main/GmOcyBM8JD.png[/img][/quote]
[size=4][b][color=#d9ead3]First steps[/color][/b][/size]
Open the Living Valley menu (brain button in the corner) or use the hotkeys:
[list]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]K[/color][/b]: Market Board[/*]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]J[/color][/b]: today's newspaper[/*]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]L[/color][/b]: Town Request Board[/*]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]H[/color][/b]: farmhand board[/*]
[/list]Then talk to any villager and pick the follow-up chat option after their normal dialogue.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#93C47D]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
The Living Valley is additive: it keeps the tone and pacing of vanilla Stardew Valley and layers new systems on top.

[list]
[*][b]Works with:[/b] major expansions (like Stardew Valley Expanded) and most custom NPC mods.[/*]
[*][b]Custom NPC lore:[/b] not automatically recognized by the conversation system.[/*]
[*][b]Portrait emotions:[/b] live emotion sync may not work out of the box for non-vanilla characters.[/*]
[*][b]Full support:[/b] lore and portrait sync for custom content needs a compatibility patch.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#93C47D]Compatibility patches[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42699]The Living Valley - SVE Compatibility Patch[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42773]The Living Valley - Daulton and Maple NPC Pack[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43103]The Living Valley - Downhill Patch and New NPCs[/url][/*]
[/list]

[size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42597/?tab=forum&topic_id=16587082][ Follow the Custom Compatibility Guide ][/url][/b][/size]
